chronological_split.method: Trades are assigned to development / validation / out-of-sample by entry time. Rule constants were frozen in code before evaluation; the out-of-sample window was not used to tune any parameter.

cost_model.model: net = gross - spread_cost - commission_cost - swap_cost; each cost = cost_price * volume, charged once per closed trade
cost_model.unit: cost_price is a PRICE distance; volume = lots * contract_size (default_calc_profit = volume * price_move), so cost is USD
cost_model.spread_unit: points (MT5 rates spread field); spread_price = points * point
cost_model.round_trip_rule: ONE full spread width per closed trade (enter at ask, exit at bid); the entry and exit bar spreads are averaged, never summed.

measured_spread.note: Mean of MT5's per-bar spread field (points) x point. A genuine measured value but a per-bar approximation, not a tick-level spread series, and not the same as a live spread snapshot.

cost_model.central_cost_basis: Shared central cost for every leg so the three are comparable. Measured from MT5's per-bar spread field where present, otherwise a labelled default.
cost_model.primary_scenario_note: The audit's headline cost is the MEASURED per-trade spread (each trade's entry/exit bar spread). The older central-mean figure is kept for continuity and is labelled as an approximation.
cost_model.omitted_costs_note: Commission and swap have no broker specification supplied, so they are modelled ONLY as explicitly labelled assumption scenarios; the headline net excludes them. No profitability claim is made from this sample.

categories.data: Invalid, insufficient, unordered or stale data
categories.spread: Spread unavailable or above the allowed maximum
categories.metadata: Broker symbol metadata missing or invalid
categories.risk: A configured risk limit or stop-distance bound failed

conditions: data: candles present, enough of them, strictly increasing and fresh
spread: a measured spread exists and is within the allowed maximum
metadata: symbol point, contract size and broker stop level are known
risk: open-position, daily-loss, aggregate-exposure and stop-distance limits
notes: The research simulator enforces the spread, stop-distance, open-position, daily-capacity and symbol/timeframe limits and reports rejections_by_reason.
The forward validator enforces the data/spread/metadata conditions and reports them as operational rejections.
No gate can force an entry; a failed gate only blocks.

daily_soft_objective.policy: The target is never enforced, never forces an entry, never increases size after a loss and never promises daily profitability; the report only counts historical days that reached it.

limitations: One symbol (XAUUSD) and one regime over the requested window; results do not generalise and no strategy is declared superior from in-sample profit or a small sample.
Research trades are hypothetical simulations, not broker fills; they are distinct from live Fibonacci signals, shadow validation and backtests.
Commission and swap are unknown and not modelled; cost is per-bar spread plus a labelled assumption grid.
The Fibonacci baseline is per-timeframe and the research strategies are multi-timeframe, so the comparison is directional, not an exact match.
Higher-timeframe rules use completed bars only, which removes (never adds) signals relative to a forward-looking rule.
order_submission: Not called. No MetaTrader order-execution function is imported or invoked anywhere in the research path.
